{{Quote|At a guess, I'd say neither of us is going to get much business done at Chazwa this time around.|[[Samuel Tomas Gillespee|Gillespee]] to [[Talon Karrde]]|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
'''Chazwa''' was a cold [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa system]] of the [[Orus sector/Legends|Orus sector]], located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Its location along a popular [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] traffic route made it an ideal shipping center for all sorts of goods. As such, heavy freighter traffic within the [[Star system/Legends|system]] was not an uncommon sight. However, the abundance of valuable merchandise moving through the system lent itself to strong influence by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].

==Description==
Chazwa [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a small [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Chazwa system/Legends|Chazwa system]]<ref name="TLCSB" /> in the [[Orus sector/Legends|Orus sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and was situated between [[Joiol]] and the [[Relatta system/Legends|Relatta system]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a medium-sized terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose terrain included plains. The world possessed a moderate amount of natural resources and featured a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], a temperate climate, a moderate hydrosphere, and mild weather.<ref name="TLCSB" /> Chazwa boasted a thriving shipping industry due to its favorable location, and the world's local economy received income from a combination of manufacturing and agriculture.<ref name="TBS" /> The planet exported information, agricultural products, and technology while importing foodstuffs and medicine.<ref name="TLCSB" />

==History==
Chazwa was part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by around [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]] and was within [[Realspace/Legends|space]] controlled by the Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During the later [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] cruiser [[Rampart (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|''Rampart'']] was assigned to the system to reduce smuggling in the area.<ref name="TLCSB" />

Chazwa was a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], but the Empire abandoned it in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] stronghold during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|Zsinj campaign]] of [[7 ABY/Legends|7]]&ndash;[[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and during [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|subsequent campaigns]] in 8 ABY, but it was lost in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="TEA" />

During his campaign, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] tricked the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] into believing Chazwa was one of his [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] sources.<ref name="TLC" /> By [[137 ABY]], Chazwa was within the territory of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Chazwa was habitable to [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and a number of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TLCSB" /> Most of Chazwa's 3.5 billion [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] inhabitants were Humans.<ref name="TBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places the Orus Sector and, consequently, Chazwa, in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].
